title: ByteCut Director: AI Video Production Workspace
summary: An open-source 'Director's Console' designed to manage complex AI video workflows, storyboard organization, and batch generation. It acts as a structured frontend for models like LTX-2, providing timeline-based shot management and cascading parameter control.
research_notes: Specifically optimized for the Wan2GP/LTX-2 ecosystem and developed under the ByteSound brand.

evolution.summary: The tool transitioned from a simple JSON queue utility for Wan2GP into a comprehensive full-stack workspace (Vite/Express). It now features a visual storyboard, timeline, version history for 'takes', and specialized tools for AI music video synchronization.
